notes: R103d targets loyalty currency consistency. PRIMARY evidence (E1–E9) establishes core loyalty accrual, redemption, and tier management rules from TOOLCHAIN-CONF-REWARDS&PANELTIES-01.md and JIRA-Rewards.md. E2 and E4 provide detailed system requirements for points accrual (only when rent Completed and payment Paid), redemption validation, and tier automation. E3 and E5 document implementation tickets noting that the exact reward formula is unfinalized and that adjustment audit logging requires confirmation on identity-resolution approach. E6 and E8 signal conflicts with I91b and R91d. E7 references a loyalty business rule definition gap. CONTEXT evidence (E10–E13) addresses broader currency consistency, billing presentation, and audit visibility gaps affecting multi-currency scenarios and financial record alignment. These CONTEXT items do not override the target's core loyalty rules but highlight that currency consistency and financial alignment remain unresolved across billing, reporting, and audit contexts. No CONTEXT evidence contradicts the operative loyalty rules; however, the gaps around currency handling, audit identity resolution, and financial record alignment are material to the target's consistency objective and must be tracked as uncertainties rather than promoted to operative rules.
